scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w apps/api" "npm run dev -w apps/web"
scripts.dev:local: concurrently -k -n db,app -c yellow,green "npm run dev:db" "tsx scripts/wait-database.ts && npm run dev"
scripts.docker:logs: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --env-file apps/web/.env logs -f api web db
scripts.test:postgres: npm run build -w apps/api && node --experimental-strip-types scripts/test-postgres.ts
scripts.format: prettier --write apps scripts docs README.md package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts
scripts.docker:public:up: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --env-file apps/web/.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.cloudflare.yaml up --build -d
scripts.docker:public:logs: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --env-file apps/web/.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.cloudflare.yaml logs -f tunnel web api db
scripts.docker:public:down: docker compose --env-file apps/api/.env --env-file apps/web/.env -f compose.yaml -f compose.cloudflare.yaml down
